metadata.title: A finite Livshits theorem and local length spectrum rigidity
metadata.abstract: We show that for closed negatively curved Riemannian manifolds whose length spectrum is exponentially separated, the length spectrum is a local isometry invariant. In particular, this holds for a dense set of negatively curved metrics. The main tool used in the proof is a finitary version of the Livshits theorem with an exponential tail.
